summary: Verified the re-separated Tipologia + Affinamento feature on backend + frontend. Backend: 11/11 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_affinamento.py — WineIn accepts affinamento up to 500 chars (501 -> 422), POST+GET persistence, update preserves both tipologia and affinamento, GET /wines includes affinamento for every doc, facets[tipologia] contains Rosso/Bianco, filter ?tipologia=Rosso filters correctly, /api/export/xlsx has both 'Tipologia' and 'Affinamento' column headers with price columns using the '#,##0.00 €' number format, /api/export/csv has both columns, round-trip export->import/preview marks all rows as 'presente' with 0 errors, and import with header synonyms 'Tipo'/'Affinamento'/'Invecchiamento' maps correctly ('bianco' is normalized to 'Bianco' on insert). Frontend: logged in as admin, created TEST_UI_Barolo with Tipologia=Rosso and a 339-char affinamento; counter data-testid 'affinamento-char-count' shows '339/500' live; datalist dl-tipologia contains all 8 required suggestions (Rosso, Bianco, Rosato, Spumante, Champagne, Orange, Dolce / Passito, Fortificato). Detail dialog badge shows 'Rosso', detail-affinamento shows the full 339-char text, detail-gradazione='14,5% vol', detail-temperatura='16-18 °C'. Re-opening the edit form keeps both tipologia='Rosso' and the full affinamento text. /carta page groups by Tipologia (ROSSO heading present), lists the wine with gradazione and 'servire a 16-18 °C', and does NOT show 'Acquisto'. Filter chip labeled 'Tipologia' is visible on /vini. Mobile 390px: /vini list has no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390). /regioni and /produttori load with 0 error elements. TEST wine was deleted via the UI delete flow; final DB has 1 wine (Amaranta — the real customer data) untouched and only the seeded admin user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analyze_import key() has an operator-precedence quirk already noted in iteration 3: `base + ((...),) if with_formato else base` — Python groups this as `base + (((...),) if with_formato else base)`, so when with_formato is False the key becomes base+base (3+3=6 elements, duplicated). Still consistent on both sides of the lookup so it is not a functional bug, but it is confusing; recommend `(base + ((w.get('formato') or '').casefold(),)) if with_formato else base`.

migrate_affinamento() runs on every startup and does a full collection scan filtered by {affinamento:{$exists:false}}. There is no index on 'affinamento' presence; fine for small collections but should be idempotently guarded (e.g., stop after first run via a settings doc) for larger datasets.

WineFormDialog: the 'Tipologia' <input> is a free-text input with datalist (not a constrained <select>), so an operator can still save an arbitrary tipologia string (e.g. 'rosso scuro'). That is matched intentionally with the migration/import normalization (which only normalizes case-insensitive EXACT matches to the canonical list), but it means the Carta grouping will create a separate section for any typo — consider a soft-warn or case-normalize on blur to keep the Carta tidy.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Aff_Brunello, TEST_Aff_Exactly500, TEST_Aff_Synonym, TEST_Aff_Synonym2 (backend tests) and TEST_UI_Barolo (frontend) — ALL cleaned up at end. Real customer wine 'Amaranta' (Tenuta Ulisse) was NOT touched. Final DB: 1 wine, 1 user (admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run full regression with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -n 0 -v  (xdist is enabled by pytest.ini with -n 2 loadscope which breaks shared state in these class-level fixtures; always override with -n 0 or isolate each test file). For UI: tipologia filter uses a Radix Select (button[role=combobox] with data-testid='filter-tipologia-select') — do NOT use page.select_option, instead click the trigger then click the option. Affinamento is a textarea with maxLength=500 and a live counter at [data-testid='affinamento-char-count']. Carta page sections are ordered by TIPOLOGIE constant: Rosso, Bianco, Rosato, Spumante, Champagne, Orange, Dolce / Passito, Fortificato, then 'Altri vini' bucket for unknown values.
